name: Arra
description: Arra is an escrow agent on Celo mainnet for importers and any deposit-plus-balance deal. The buyer locks the order total in USDT, or converts naira (cNGN) at one firm Textile FX rate. The supplier gets the deposit the moment they accept from their own wallet; the balance stays in the ArraVault contract until shipping or delivery, with part payments and one-tap splits. The agent watches every order's deadlines and sends the tagged transaction that refunds the buyer (not accepted or not shipped in time) or pays the supplier (no problem raised in the check period). It can only trigger outcomes the contract allows, never redirect money. Also: order-sheet checks for vague terms, container-number check digits, a payee-change alarm, a Chinese supplier page, history and receipts.
